initial.title: 开放共学场
initial.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a substantially more resolved new concept for the university institution 培菁矩阵. The attached old logo is a direction reference: keep its idea of an open shared central space and mutually relating planar forms, but rethink its fragmented cube silhouette and its clumsy dark wordmark; it is not a final shape to trace. Design a flat single-ink deep navy identity on pure white, horizontal lockup, symbol left and accurately written Chinese name 培菁矩阵 right. The institution is a cross-disciplinary student-and-mentor learning community (design assumption), modern, intellectually confident, open and collaborative. Explore broad interdependent planes that define one generous white passage through the center, with a striking coherent outer silhouette, carefully balanced unequal masses and optically intentional openings. Avoid an isometric cube, a generic four-corner scanner frame, radial pinwheel, scattered polygons or thin protruding tails. Give the lettering equally serious attention: readable Chinese skeletons, considered compact proportions and subtle terminal geometry that belongs to the planar symbol, restrained medium weight rather than default massive bold type. Name must be exactly 培菁矩阵, including full 艹 and 青 in 菁; do not substitute 精. The visible design should stand on its own without explanatory symbolism. One resolved logo only, centered in generous white space, symbol and wordmark together occupying about 75% of canvas width. Flat dark ink only, crisp edges, no shading, no gradient, no texture, no mockup, no English, no labels, no comparison panels, no guide grid. Landscape canvas.

initial.title: 交织成章
initial.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design an original, refined flat logo for a university cross-disciplinary learning institution named exactly 培菁矩阵, students and mentors learning and building projects together (test brief). Produce one complete horizontal lockup on pure white: compact symbol left, readable custom-considered Chinese lettering on right. One dark navy ink only. Explore a compact interwoven form where broad continuous stroke paths pass over and under one another and their white interruption makes the crossing legible. The paths should feel like an intellectually composed written gesture, with tension between straight architectural stretches and controlled turning curves; the silhouette must have a deliberate asymmetric opening rather than becoming a closed Celtic knot. It should feel academic, mature and contemporary, not a startup infinity icon, DNA helix, flower, four-loop app logo, neural network or decorative interlaced mess. Keep a lucid large-scale silhouette with few spatial decisions; fine line detail is unnecessary. Chinese lettering should echo the stroke endings and tension of the mark while retaining exact character skeletons, comfortable counters and optical spacing. Use a refined moderate-weight Chinese lettering treatment, not a generic heavy sans-serif label. Actual wording only 培菁矩阵 (培 = 土+咅; 菁 = 艹+青; 矩 = 矢+巨; 阵 = 阝+车). No invented English or small print. Avoid forced pictorial meaning or additional education symbols. Symbol and lettering are one balanced identity, about 75% canvas width with ample white margins. No gradients, material, shadows, embossing, mockup or explanatory graphics. Landscape canvas, one logo.

initial.title: 菁序字标
initial.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a sophisticated Chinese wordmark-led identity for the university institution named exactly 培菁矩阵. This is a modern cross-disciplinary learning community, academically credible, open, and oriented to shared growth. Use just those four Chinese characters, in one readable horizontal line on white, one deep navy ink; no separate symbol. Typography itself must carry the identity. Design considered Chinese lettering with a restrained contemporary humanist editorial character: measured thick/thin stroke tension rather than ordinary bold sans, generous interior counters, optically balanced widths despite different stroke densities. Develop a consistent family of slightly flared square-cut terminals and deliberate open internal spaces so the four characters feel designed together. The large horizontal strokes and vertical supports should have compositional rhythm across the word rather than a default-font look or mechanically equal boxes. Preserve all structural components and clear Chinese reading; avoid stretched glyphs, forced ligatures, ornamental cutouts, ancient seal script, calligraphic brush texture, a 2x2 layout or a large gap splitting the name in half. Exact wording 培菁矩阵, including 菁 with 艹 over 青, never 精 or 青 alone. No added letters, slogans, date or annotation. A single meticulously resolved wordmark, approximately 70% canvas width in a generously spaced landscape frame. Flat crisp edges, no material, shadows, gradients or poster graphics. Aim for a university cultural platform with quiet presence and distinctive lettering decisions, not decorative typography or a packaged font specimen.

refinement.prompt: Refine this existing logo, preserving the exact Chinese name 培菁矩阵, the open shared-center planar idea, horizontal arrangement, navy ink and white background. Main repair: make the assembled symbol less fragmented and balance its mass with the wordmark. Integrate the small isolated lower-right shard into the adjacent lower plane as one clean continuous termination; avoid adding more shapes. Preserve the generous central passage, main planar angles and the open upper-right region, do not close it into a solid cube. Scale the symbol down relative to the lettering so its height is about one and a half times the Chinese cap height, with a clearly generous gap. Keep the four Chinese skeletons and current readable basic style, slightly lighten their heavy strokes and open cramped counters rather than merely replacing them with an unrelated font. Match clean terminal cuts between symbol and letters, without deleting character strokes. Flatten the entire artwork to ONE uniform deep navy ink on pure white: no shading, paper texture, gradients or shadows. Crisp logo artwork only, no annotations, no new wording, keep landscape white margins. Do not add a detached fragment or tiny tail elsewhere.

Refine this existing university logo for 培菁矩阵. Keep the same compact interwoven broad-stroke identity, central opening, horizontal symbol-plus-Chinese arrangement, exact correct Chinese characters and navy-on-white palette. Main repair: resolve the disconnected upper-right pointed shard and the inconsistent stroke endings so the symbol reads as a controlled interweaving rather than flying fragments or rotating arrows. Reconnect or integrate that upper-right shard as a restrained continuation of the adjoining upper stroke; keep an optically clean white channel to show a logical over-under relationship. Do not add loops, extra stripes, arrowheads or new decorative parts. Preserve the distinctive asymmetrical outer sweep and broad negative-space center. Reduce the symbol relative to the text by roughly 12%, retaining generous whitespace between them. Do not introduce gaps that turn a character into a different glyph, do not simply use heavy generic sans serif. The core task is consistent terminations and coherent interweaving; keep other proportions stable. Output one clean flat deep-navy logo, absolutely solid single ink with NO gradient, no lighting, no texture, no shading, on pure white. No extra words or presentation panels. Landscape canvas.

Replace only that detached wedge with the surrounding clean white background. Do not reconnect it, do not add another piece, no new stroke anywhere. symmetry.prompt: Edit the provided 培菁矩阵 university-institution logo into ONE resolved bilaterally symmetric version. Main change: redesign ONLY the symbol from its rotating woven motif into an exactly LEFT-RIGHT MIRROR SYMMETRIC mark around a vertical central axis. Preserve its broad interwoven ribbon/stroke character and generous white center, its restrained deep navy ink, and the exact four-character Chinese name 培菁矩阵 in the existing gently modulated lettering style. The result should feel calm, architecturally balanced and academically credible, not a spinning corporate technology icon. The left and right outer contours, stroke widths, turns, cut ends and inner apertures must mirror one another precisely. Build an open shared central passage with the mirrored strokes: broad, lucid silhouette, controlled curved-to-straight transitions, no small detached fragments. Keep the center visually open and unfilled, and an opening in the top or bottom boundary so it does not become a closed shield. Allow one simple central crossing or diamond-shaped counterform only if it strengthens the coherent mirrored silhouette. Avoid rotational pinwheel symmetry, arrows, ornate Celtic knots, hearts, wings, shield badges, literal books or mortarboards, extra dots and decorative tiny notches. Make a centered vertical lockup: symbol above, the four accurate Chinese characters centered in one horizontal line beneath, generous comfortable gap. Symbol should be about 45 percent of wordmark width; wordmark should occupy about 62 percent of canvas width, restrained scale and ample pure-white margins. No added words, English, captions, annotations or alternate panels. Pure flat solid deep navy shapes on pure white, no gradients, texture, lighting, bevels, shadows or mockup. Deliver a clean square logo concept image. This is a symmetry refinement of the attached identity, not a new unrelated brand.

Simplify ONLY the mirrored symbol in this provided logo while preserving its exact left-right mirror symmetry and the exact Chinese wordmark 培菁矩阵 beneath it. It currently contains too many duplicate parallel ribbon layers. Remove the two thin inner diagonal bands just underneath the upper broad arches, AND remove the two outer lower parallel strips. Retain only FOUR broad pieces in total: the mirrored upper-left and upper-right arching strokes, plus the mirrored lower-left and lower-right turning strokes. These four broad strokes should define one generous open central white passage, with balanced clear white separations, a simple calm outer silhouette and no extra filigree. Preserve the existing broad curved-corner/straight-terminal language. Do not fill the center, do not add other shapes, no thin remnants, no tiny cutouts. This must be an intentional balanced institutional mark, not a decorative woven knot. Keep the symbol centered above the unchanged wordmark, and shrink its total width slightly relative to the text, from about 65% to about 55% of the wordmark width. Keep generous gap and all four Chinese characters accurate, retaining current lettering style. Flat solid deep navy on clean pure white, no gradient or texture. Same square canvas and comfortable margins. One complete vertical logo only, no annotations.
